lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a regular spatial frequency, with the largest and brightest clusters located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a rectilinear grid. The intersection nodes are marked by the highest local luminance values.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank. These features are defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, characterized by a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge, extending from the branchial region towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 15-20 small, discrete, high-luminance spots. These spots are distributed non-uniformly, with a higher concentration towards the base and central region of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 8-10 elongated, low-luminance silhouettes representing commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral region, specifically clustered near the base and trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
